subject: improve _withSecret() performance

units.name: improve _withSecret() performance
units.evidence: The changed 256-byte withSecret target compiles to differing IR but Alive2 fails to prove either direction; helper calls remain opaque in other fixed targets.

units.name: scalar long-secret body and fixed 256-byte public specialization with neutralized inline hints
units.precondition: XXH_VECTOR=0; XXH_NO_INLINE_HINTS=1 on both sides; 256-byte input and 192-byte secret for public wrapper
units.evidence: Clang 18 old/new -O0 and -O2 LLVM IR is byte-identical; Alive2 verifies wrapper, inline entry, and changed long-secret helper in both directions. Original differing inline hints are not compared end to end.

notes: Exact-source partial proof for scalar long-secret body and fixed public specialization with both inline hints neutralized; original hint configurations and remaining public paths are unresolved.
